architecture: Express-served vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript beside an existing operational console
existing_ui: The current operational surface is an inline HTML document in src/flytown/web.ts and remains at /fly
tokens: No reusable public-site token system existed before this change
typography: The operational console uses system sans and monospace; the public identity requires self-hosted display, reading, and data faces
motion: No motion library is present; the public site uses one CSS-authored hero reveal and respects prefers-reduced-motion
dependencies: No frontend framework, component library, or icon dependency is introduced
route_risk: Changing / affects CLI browser entry and Electron; /fly remains stable and Electron is redirected there
theme: Custom State of the Experiment direction approved by the user
